From: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>

Date: 2028-06-12T14:05:00-07:00
Subject: Post-demo: Security follow-up & processor contact grid

Hi Samuel,

Thanks again for taking the demo earlier today — appreciate the thoughtful questions. Quick recap and the security + subprocessor follow-ups we discussed:

- SOC 2: Redwood is undergoing annual SOC 2 Type II audits. Our most recent in-scope period ended May 2028; consolidated report is expected to be available Q3 2028. I’ve attached a short redwood-soc2-summary.pdf with the current controls map and timeline.
- Privacy & regulations: We support GDPR controls and offer HIPAA-eligible deployments (BAA available). For your PHI workflows we recommend Redwood Private (VPC) or Dedicated with customer-managed keys.
- Subprocessors & cloud: Attached is a draft subprocessor_matrix.csv listing primary cloud providers (AWS us-east-1), CDN, logging & metrics (Datadog), object storage, and analytics vendors. We'll finalize versions for contract.
- Next asks: can you confirm which of the following you need from us: SOC 2 report copy, BAA, encryption key controls (KMS/HSM), data residency guarantees, or a completed vendor security questionnaire?

Attachments: redwood-soc2-summary.pdf, subprocessor_matrix.csv

Proposed next steps:
1) Please send your security questionnaire (or we can provide our standard questionnaire) — if you can share by end of week, we'll return answers within 3 business days.
2) If HIPAA/BAA is gating, loop in your legal (who should I talk to?).
3) 30-minute follow-up call next Wed (June 19) to review evidence and finalize processor roster.

Happy to jump on a call with Ben/Karthik if you want to review technical details.

Best,
Ava Chen
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
ava.chen@redwood.com
From: Samuel Park <sam.park@healthsync.com>

Cc: Anna Lee <anna.lee@healthsync.com>, legal@healthsync.com
Date: 2028-06-12T16:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo: Security follow-up & processor contact grid

Thanks Ava — good recap. A few clarifications from our side: 

- SOC 2: We need a copy of the most recent SOC 2 Type II report (or bridge letter if final report not yet available) before procurement approval.
- HIPAA: HealthSync handles PHI; we require a BAA in place prior to any production data. Can Redwood provide a BAA template and confirm who on your legal team we should work with?
- Data residency: our initial workload must remain in AWS us-east-1. Is that supported for Redwood Private / Dedicated?
- Questionnaire: I’m attaching our standard vendor questionnaire (sending separately). Procurement timeline is tight — target decision by 2028-07-15.

On a practical note, who will complete the spreadsheet with final subprocessors (we need versions with exact vendor product names and subprocessors for storage, logging, ML infra, and analytics)?

Thanks,
Sam

Samuel — thanks, noted. Answers inline and next steps below.

- SOC 2: We can provide a bridge letter now and the full Type II report when finalized in Q3. I’ve attached a controls snapshot to the first email for your review.
- BAA: We do offer a standard BAA for HIPAA-eligible customers. I’ll introduce you to our contracts lead (cc’ing Ben) to get the ball rolling; Ben, can Legal share a BAA template and the primary contact?
- Data residency: Yes — Redwood Private and Dedicated can be restricted to AWS us-east-1 for processing and storage. For Hosted this is more limited; we’ll document routing and storage boundaries in the subprocessor matrix.
- Subprocessors: Here's the short roster we discussed (will populate CSV with versions):
  * Compute: AWS EC2 (us-east-1)
  * Object storage: S3 (us-east-1)
  * Caching/kv: ElastiCache/Redis
  * Metrics/logging: Datadog
  * Observability traces: Honeycomb (optional)
  * Analytics: Segment (customer-controlled)
  * Monitoring & incident: PagerDuty

I’m attaching a partially completed security-questionnaire.xlsx with answers to the sections I can confirm (controls, encryption at rest/in transit, key management options, logging retention). Please have your procurement/legal review; we’ll fill any vendor-specific fields you send.

Action items:
- Ben: please prepare BAA template and confirm legal contact for HealthSync.
- Karthik: prepare a more detailed subprocessor matrix tied to the agreed architecture (include exact product names and any subcontracted providers).
- Samuel/Anna: send the vendor questionnaire (or confirm if you prefer us to import your form into our template).

Drive with evidence: https://drive.google.com/drive/fakeid/security-evidence
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/999999/deal/12345

Best,
Ava
